name: The Oriental Planes of Buttes-Chaumont

location.address: Parc des Buttes-Chaumont, mid-slope above the lake, 7 rue Botzaris, 75019 Paris

access: Free public park, open daily 7:00 to 20:00 (to 21:00 or later in summer; paris.fr hours table read 2026-10-30).
transport: Botzaris or Buttes Chaumont (line 7bis), at the park gate on rue Botzaris
verify_notes: ENSEMBLE of three register trees within 10 m: 102141 (girth 740 cm, 30 m), 102140 (580 cm, 30 m), 102139 (570 cm, 31 m); one standing place, one entry. Register coordinates 48.88034,2.38129 / 48.88040,2.38130 / 48.88040,2.38138, which land on Avenue Alphand (a path), no OSM tree node, so approximate. paris.fr's park feature calls them three immense Oriental planes (Platanus orientalis) with bumpy trunks and thick upright branches, standing mid-slope on a thick bed of ivy sloping to the lake, planted 1865 after fifteen years in nursery, largest circumference 6.70 m. CONFLICT: register says Platanus x hispanica (common plane) with 740/580/570 cm; paris.fr says orientalis and 6.70 m; species left as London Plane per register, both noted. Age basis: documented planting 1865 (paris.fr article, says these three) plus 15 years nursery, so roughly 160 years in the ground. The register's 740 cm is the widest plane in the Paris register per a secondary page (not used as source). Park laid out 1864 to 1867 under Alphand. One-line reason: three of the widest planes in Paris on a ivy slope above the lake. Alive: iNaturalist observation inside the lifecheck radius (not tree-specific), so thin; register-listed and maintained by the city.

name: The Black Walnut of Lac Daumesnil

location.address: Route de la Ceinture du Lac Daumesnil, Bois de Vincennes, 75012 Paris

access: Free; the Bois de Vincennes is open public woodland, the tree stands beside the lake ring road and is visible from the road (city sheet).

verify_notes: Register 2002367: girth 605 cm, height 26 m, planted 1845. Girth conflict 605 (register) vs 580 (sheet): different dates, both given. Age basis: documented planting 1845 for this specimen. One-line reason: a three-stem black walnut with a visible old wound, 1845, nationally labelled. verify_notes: ENSEMBLE: five register planes, all planted 1860 per register, on a 2 ha island, one place to stand: 2002365 (430 cm, 40 m; listed twice in the candidate file, one tree), 2041448 (420 cm, 40 m), 2002364 (410 cm, 35 m), 2041444 (400 cm, 32 m), 2041452 (395 cm, 35 m). Register points 10 to 50 m apart; OSM natural=tree nodes 'Platane commun' sit at or within about 5 m of three of them (48.83205,2.41092; 48.83238,2.41144), so the ensemble centre is confirmed to the island. paris.fr's island page (figures dated 2011): a plane planted 1860, 45 m tall, 4.05 m girth; a second plane planted 1895, 35 m, 5.10 m girth (not in our candidate file, a lead: the widest on the island and not located); also a 1870 yew, 1930 tulip tree, 1930 bald cypress, 1935 persimmon.
